title: Unifying Variational View of Accelerated Primal-Dual Methods
summary: We develop a unifying variational framework for accelerated primal-dual flows in affinely constrained convex optimization. In particular, it is shown that applying the Euler-Lagrange-Rayleigh (ELR) principle to coupled augmented Bregman Lagrangians systematically generates accelerated dynamics over general Bregman geometries and recovers a family of existing primal-dual mirror and Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) flows as special cases.
